hero.eyebrow: Simple finance software for independent service businesses
hero.title: A Clear View of Your Business Finances
hero.body: Manage your schedule and finances in one place. Track revenue from every client, break down profit by service category, and make informed decisions with clear insights that are always at your fingertips.

states.title: Completed work, revenue, payments and open-order balances are tracked separately.
states.body: A visit can be completed before it counts toward revenue. A prepaid package can cover a visit without a new payment, while an open order may still have an outstanding amount. Perelai keeps these states separate so each figure has a clear meaning.

drivers.title: See where the result comes from
drivers.body: Review revenue by service category, costs by category, a client's revenue history and how the result changes over time.

records.title: Every figure has work behind it
records.body: Payments are recorded against the visit, order or instalment they paid for, and stay connected to the relevant client and service category.

operations.title: Build the financial record as you work
operations.body: Complete a visit, record a payment, add a cost or redeem a package. Booking, Calendar and Inbox keep these actions connected to clients and services. Clients can also book through your own link.

problem.title: You already know this day
problem.pain1Body: Clients message at 11 pm. You screenshot the request, promise to check your calendar tomorrow, and forget by morning.
problem.pain2Body: What colour formula did she use last time? It is in a note, or a text, or the back of a receipt — somewhere.
problem.pain3Body: "What did I actually earn this week?" You piece it together from Venmo, cash, and a client who said she would pay next time.

inbox.title: The Inbox that stays until you deal with it
inbox.body: A notification tells you something happened. The Inbox keeps it until you deal with it. Unconfirmed bookings, unpaid visits, clients due for a follow-up — one list of what still needs your decision.
inbox.caption: Example data
inbox.detail: One list of what still needs your decision — it stays there until you resolve it, not until you read it.

booking.title: One link for your bio
booking.body: Share one link. Clients pick a service, a person and a time. Put it in your bio, send it in a DM, print it on a card — it is yours.
booking.detail: Your booking link is yours. Clients book directly on your link.

money.title: Revenue, costs and outstanding amounts on open orders
money.body: Completed work, revenue and actually recorded payments are accounted for separately. So instead of a single mixed figure, you see the different financial states of the business.
money.caption: Example data
money.detail: Completed work, revenue and actually recorded payments are accounted for separately. So instead of a single mixed figure, you see the different financial states of the business.

devices.title: One address, one login
devices.body: Perelai runs in a web browser. Sign in at perelai.app from wherever you are working and you are in the same workspace. On iPhone you can add it to your Home Screen, where it opens from its own icon in its own window. Installing it is optional, and there is no App Store or Google Play listing.
devices.caption: Example data
devices.summary: One Perelai workspace, opened from a supported browser on a phone, a tablet or a computer.

collaboration.title: Work solo. Add people when you need them.
collaboration.body: Start with your own workspace. Add team access only when it becomes useful.
collaboration.teamBody: Invite team members with Staff or Supervisor access. Keep schedules, time off and assigned services together.
collaboration.notesDetail: Pinned client notes and visit notes stay with the client history.

setup.title: Set up in an evening
setup.body: No weekend migration. Pick your trade, import your clients, share your link.
setup.step1Body: 32 selectable business types, each with an editable service list. Relevant templates also include add-ons and linked costs.
setup.step2Body: Import contacts from your phone with vCard. Connect your Google Calendar and keep both sides in step.
setup.step3Body: One link in your bio. Clients book directly on your own link.

not.title: What Perelai is not
not.body: If you need any of these, we are not the right fit — and we would rather say so.
not.item1Body: Perelai tracks revenue, costs, calculated profit, recorded payments and what is still owed on open orders, with category and client breakdowns. It does not file taxes, reconcile bank accounts, produce statutory reports or give financial advice.
not.item2Body: Your booking link is yours. Clients book directly without a marketplace intermediary.
not.item3Body: No clinical records, no diagnosis tracking, no patient treatment management.

faq.title: Questions

q_category.question: Is this accounting software?
q_category.answer: No. Perelai is operational finance software. It tracks revenue, costs, calculated profit, recorded payments and what is still owed on open orders, with category and client breakdowns. It does not file taxes, reconcile bank accounts, produce statutory reports or give financial advice.

q_bank.question: Will the number match my bank?
q_bank.answer: Not always. Summary revenue represents completed work that has been settled, and a prepaid package can settle a visit without moving money. Recorded payments and payment-account balances show money movement separately.

faq.q1: How do clients book with me?
faq.a1: Share your direct booking link. Clients choose a service and time directly on your page.
faq.q2: What happens right after I sign up?
faq.a2: You confirm your email, then a short setup: your trade, your services, your team if you have one, and optional imports.
faq.q3: Will my services already be there?
faq.a3: Yes — each selectable business type starts with an editable service or item list. Relevant templates also include add-ons and linked costs.
faq.q4: Can I bring my clients and calendar across?
faq.a4: Yes: contacts from your phone (vCard) and two-way Google Calendar sync.
faq.q5: Can I manage multiple services and add-ons?
faq.a5: Yes. Each template includes selectable services and relevant add-on options.
faq.a6: No. Perelai is operational finance software. It tracks revenue, costs, calculated profit, recorded payments and what is still owed on open orders, with category and client breakdowns. It does not file taxes, reconcile bank accounts, produce statutory reports or give financial advice.
faq.q7: Does Perelai have an iPhone or Android app?
faq.a7: Perelai is finance software for independent service businesses. Perelai is not listed on the App Store or on Google Play; it runs in a web browser at perelai.app instead. Installing Perelai from a browser is optional and not offered by every browser. Perelai needs an internet connection.
faq.q8: Can I use Perelai on a laptop or an iPad?
faq.a8: Open perelai.app in a supported browser and sign in with the same login you use on your phone. One login, one workspace. An internet connection is required.
